headline: France's AFD Signs $60 Million Loan Deals With Nigerian Banks
summary: Agence Française de Développement signed two loan agreements totaling $60 million with Bank of Industry and Sterling Bank. The funds will target Nigeria's creative, agricultural, and renewable energy sectors.
why: AFD is France's public bilateral development finance agency. External credit facilities provide targeted liquidity to financial institutions in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Concessional loans expand financing access for Nigerian small and medium enterprises.
